        n,h,w=map(int,m.groups())

        om=re.fullmatch(r'Demo pair (\d+) output \((\d+)x(\d+)\):',lines[oi].strip())

        exp=[list(map(int,lines[oi+1+r].split())) for r in range(h)]
        pairs.append((inp,exp))
        i=oi+1+h
